blocks.title: The deploy gap
blocks.dek: Six PRs merged to main this afternoon. None of them reached prod. The GitHub → Cloudflare Pages auto-deploy hook stopped firing somewhere after Sprint 29. Caught it at 16:47 PT, recovered via wrangler in three minutes. Here's the timeline.
